summary: @servicetitan/culture preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses `execFileSync` to invoke it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob with hex-named identifiers (`_0x...`), a shuffled string/numeric array (`n7gIxM=[...]`) and a rotator function (`WV8StW`), carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header indicating it is compiled for the Bun runtime. The package advertises itself as an i18n/culture helper for a React UI kit (homepage docs.st.dev, repo servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib, `main` pointing to a small React helper in `dist/index.js`) — a purpose that has no need to fetch an alternate language runtime or execute an obfuscated payload at install time. The alien-runtime fetch is used specifically to execute code that Node-based inspection tooling in the installer's pipeline cannot readily analyze, and the payload runs automatically on `npm install` under the installer's user account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
